record.title: Clinical and Hemato-Biochemical Studies on Ehrlichiosis and Babesiosis in Canines
record.abstract: Canines presented with high temperature, inappetance, ecchymotic hemorrhages on ventral abdomen, epistaxis and tick infestation were evaluated for clinical, hematological and biochemical aspects of hemoprotozoan diseases. Ehrlichia and Babesia were the common hemoprotozoan observed. The dogs were treated with Oxytetracycline in ehrlichiosis and Diminazene aceturate in Babesiosis along with supportive therapy to increase platelet count and liver supplements.

screening.rationale: Clinical and haemato-biochemical study in naturally infected dogs; abstract gives no results, so the depth of organ-function data needs full text.
